wiki.title: Ted Cruz
wiki.extract: Rafael Edward Cruz (born December 22, 1970) is an American politician and attorney serving as the junior United States Senator from Texas since 2013. A member of the Republican Party, he served as the third Solicitor General of Texas from 2003 to 2008. He has chaired the Senate Commerce Committee since 2025.
